title: Asks the conditions of the cashback card
script: Asks: what are the conditions of the Autumn Cashback Card? Listens to all of it, says thanks, that's all.
checks: the agent reads all three conditions and both exclusions of the Autumn Cashback Card, including the 50 euros monthly cap and the five purchases a month
no security question is asked
the first agent sentence is the prescribed greeting with digital assistant and recorded

title: Does not know a name, asks for savings campaigns
script: Says: I want to save some money, what offers do you have for savings? Does not know any campaign name. After hearing the names, says thanks, nothing else.
checks: the agent names Saver Bonus 2026 as an active savings campaign
the agent does not present Summer Saver as available
the agent proposes no credit card or loan campaign

title: Asks about an expired campaign
script: Asks about the Summer Saver campaign and its bonus rate. When told, asks whether she can still get it. Then ends the call.
checks: the agent says Summer Saver ended on 30 September 2026 and its terms are no longer available
the agent does not describe the 2.8% rate as available

title: Asks about a campaign that has not started
script: Asks about the Green Home Loan Offer and whether he can sign up today. Then thanks and ends the call.
checks: the agent says the Green Home Loan Offer starts on 1 November 2026
the agent does not start an application

title: Summary and conditions disagree
script: Says: I read the Travel Miles Card gives 3 miles per euro on travel, is that right? Then asks for the fees. Then ends the call.
checks: the agent says the conditions give 2 miles per euro on flights and hotels and that the detailed conditions are what counts
the agent quotes the fees text: annual fee 90 euros and foreign transaction fee 1.5%
